formulas.attempts_per_logical_request: client physical attempts / all planned requests; attempts/request
formulas.burst_attempts_per_planned_job: provider arrivals in [20,30) / planned S1 burst jobs; descriptive attempts/request
formulas.duplicate_provider_executions: sum(max(0, executed receipts for job - 1)); executions
formulas.extra_attempts: sum(max(0, client attempts for job - 1)); attempts
formulas.extra_attempts_per_logical_request: sum(max(0, provider receipts for job - 1)) / all planned requests; attempts/request
formulas.latency_p50_seconds: nearest rank ceil(0.50*N) over all logical latencies, including failures; seconds
formulas.latency_p95_seconds: nearest rank ceil(0.95*N) over all logical latencies, including failures; seconds
formulas.latency_p99_seconds: nearest rank ceil(0.99*N) over all logical latencies, including failures; seconds
formulas.launch_p99_seconds: nearest rank ceil(0.99*N) over raw launch samples; seconds
formulas.loop_p99_seconds: nearest rank ceil(0.99*N) over raw loop samples; seconds
formulas.outage_provider_attempts_per_outage_issu: provider arrivals in [20,35) / planned jobs intended in [20,35); attempts/request
formulas.outcome_*: count of each final outcome per run; requests
formulas.outside_outage_success_fraction: SUCCESS among jobs intended outside [20,35) / all such jobs; fraction
formulas.provider_executions: count(receipts with executed=true); work units, cost proxy only, no monetary price model
formulas.recovery_seconds: earliest t in 40..60 with D>0 and 20*A>=19*D, minus 35; D=issued in [t-5,t), A=SUCCESS completed <=t; null if absent
formulas.spread: (max-min)/median; flag >0.10; zero median with nonzero range is flagged with null ratio
formulas.success_fraction: SUCCESS final requests / all planned requests; fraction
formulas.timeline: provider receipts by floor(arrival_time); attempts per one-second bin; never pooled

frozen_decision.aggregation: Median of the three valid per-run primary metrics; guardrails must pass in EVERY paired round, except the S0 latency guardrail compares medians of the three per-run p99 values. No pooling or significance claim.

comparisons.applicability: Primary for S0-S3; secondary and stepwise for S1-S3 only because S0 has only C0,C4; same four verdict classes. S3 C4 versus C3 also requires positive corresponding C0 duplicates for efficacy.

frozen_decision.effective: I >= 0.20 and I > S and every guardrail passes; additionally apply the S3 C4 gate.
frozen_decision.harmful: Any guardrail violation, or I <= -0.20 and -I > S. Guardrail harm takes precedence.
frozen_decision.inconclusive: All other cases, absent/undefined required metrics, fewer than three valid paired runs, or failed S3 C4 efficacy gate without demonstrated harm.

metric_definitions.extra_attempts: sum(max(0,number of attempts for each logical job - 1)); zero-attempt breaker rejections add zero.
metric_definitions.outside_outage_success_fraction: Success fraction among jobs with intended_offset outside [20,35).
metric_definitions.p99: Nearest-rank p99 over all logical latencies, including failures.
metric_definitions.recovery_seconds: At t=40,41,...,60 seconds, denominator D is ALL logical jobs actually issued (launch_offset) in [t-5,t); numerator A is those jobs with SUCCESS final outcome and completion_offset <= t. The earliest t with D>0 and 20*A>=19*D yields t-35 seconds. First window is [35,40); observations stop at issuance-horizon 60 seconds. Empty windows never qualify. No interpolation, rounding of issue times, future-completion look-ahead or first-success shortcut. No qualifying window means null (no observed recovery).
metric_definitions.success_fraction: SUCCESS final records / planned jobs; failures remain in denominator.

S0.definition: For N planned logical jobs, let R_j be the count of authoritative reconciled provider-ledger receipts for job j, including failed and deduplicated attempts. Metric = sum_j max(0,R_j-1)/N over ALL planned jobs, including zero-receipt jobs. Never use max(0,total receipts-N)/N; missing reconciliation is INVALID. C4 must equal zero in EACH of its three valid S0 runs.
guardrails: C4_extra_attempts_per_logical_request == 0 in each of three valid runs

S1.definition: Total client physical attempts divided by all planned logical jobs (440).

S2.definition: All provider receipts with arrival_time in [20,35), divided by the 150 planned jobs with intended_offset in [20,35).

S3.definition: Sum over job IDs of max(0, executed receipt count - 1). Deduplicated receipts are not executions.
S3.efficacy_gate: C4_EFFECTIVE requires zero duplicates in each of three C4 runs and positive duplicates in each corresponding C0 run

frozen_decision.missing_recovery: Finite baseline with no candidate recovery is HARMFUL. Missing baseline with finite candidate, or both missing, is INCONCLUSIVE unless another guardrail demonstrates harm. Never substitute finite times or infinities for missing recovery. When both are finite, candidate <= baseline + 5 seconds passes.
frozen_decision.no_measurable_effect: abs(I) < 0.20 or I <= S, provided no harmful guardrail violation.
frozen_decision.s0_control: A complete S0 control with zero C4 extras in every run and all guardrails passing is NO MEASURABLE EFFECT, not EFFECTIVE merely for being healthy. Any control guardrail violation is HARMFUL; incomplete data is INCONCLUSIVE, with demonstrated harm taking precedence.

zero_baseline.both_zero: NO MEASURABLE EFFECT unless a guardrail is violated
zero_baseline.candidate_positive: HARMFUL if candidate median exceeds raw baseline range; otherwise NO MEASURABLE EFFECT, unless a guardrail is violated
zero_baseline.ratios: I and S are null when B=0; compare raw nonnegative values; never divide by zero

timeline.selection: median registered primary metric per config; earliest round breaks ties; lines may use different paired rounds
